purpose: Explicit source selection for a prospective curated-canada-v4. It preserves curated-canada-v3 and adds one hash-pinned, Alberta-wide, historical tame-pasture assessment semantic companion to the extended profile only. The companion supplies qualitative observation and monitoring context, not a score, classification, species identification, legal determination, grazing or renewal direction, field prediction, or management prescription.

profiles.description: The v1 compact Canadian field-guidance core, unchanged to preserve its release boundary. Its geographic depth is intentionally uneven and all row-level historical, currency, and live-authority restrictions remain active.

The curated-canada-v3 extended profile plus four reviewed, context-only Alberta historical tame-pasture monitoring records. They apply only to Alberta tame pasture and do not classify a site, assign a score, identify a regulated weed, prescribe grazing or renovation, or establish an individual field outcome.
